sections.skill: Plan box size, checking, renewals and address updates

questions.prompt: Why plan how often to check a business mailbox?

choices.text: Boxes must be emptied every hour by law
Checking often lowers the rental fee

questions.intro: Practical choices matter once you have a mailbox. PO Boxes come in sizes and are rented for set periods, such as 3, 6 or 12 months; fees vary by location and size. Plan how often you will check it: important letters, such as tax notices or bills, can have deadlines. Decide who may pick up mail, keep keys safe, and ask how large packages are handled. When moving, update your address with banks, customers and agencies; forwarding may help for a while but does not replace updating records. Renew before the rental period ends.

questions.prompt: Choosing a mailbox size is like what?
questions.intro: Renting a mailbox is like renting a small storage unit. You pick a size, pay for a set period, keep the key safe, and check on it regularly. If you forget to pay, the unit can be closed. If you move your things, you tell people your new location. A business mailbox works the same way, with letters and packages instead of boxes of belongings.
